commonActorFiles.incident.md: Synthetic incident at 14:10 UTC. One Java service pod is approaching a 3 GiB memory limit. Drain/restart is already authorized for 14:11 UTC; evidence budget is at most 40 seconds using existing metrics/logs or a bounded command plan. Heap dumps and new long profiles do not fit the budget. Warm process, same deployment and work mix. No production process is accessible in this fixture. Diagnose only what the supplied evidence supports.
